title: Last 12 months runs from the 1st of the month eleven months back to today
pre_body:
Preconditions

  1. User: you are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. Location: you are in one location (workplace).
  3. Browser: you use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1024 pixels wide (any ordinary laptop or desktop monitor).
  4. Before you start: Work out the expected window for the day you test: start = the 1st of the month eleven months before this month, end = today. Example, testing on 7 October 2026: November 1, 2025 to October 7, 2026, which is 341 days counting both ends (30+31+31+28+31+30+31+30+31+31+30 = 334 days for November to September, plus 7).
